title: Wire up deal scoring and sorting logic in CrossModelSearchPage

requirements.summary: Wire deal score badge rendering and result grouping in CrossModelSearchPage to match backend dealScore field with proper tier ordering and color coding
acceptanceCriteria: The highlighted 'Good Deal' section only contains listings whose `dealScore` field equals 'Good Deal'.
Deal score badges display green/emerald for 'Good Deal', amber/yellow for 'Fair', and red for 'Overpriced'.
Listings with a missing or empty `dealScore` are treated as 'Fair' and display the amber/yellow badge.
The result list is visually grouped: 'Good Deal' listings in a highlighted section appear before 'Fair' and 'Overpriced' listings.
Within each tier, listings are ordered by price ascending.
The secondary make/model text filter correctly narrows results across all tiers without disrupting the tier grouping.

file_operations.description: Update deal score badge rendering to use green/emerald for 'Good Deal', amber/yellow for 'Fair', and red for 'Overpriced'. Ensure the 'Good Deal' section filter checks `dealScore === 'Good Deal'` exactly. Treat missing or empty dealScore as 'Fair'. Verify the result grouping logic displays 'Good Deal' listings first in a highlighted section, followed by 'Fair' and 'Overpriced' listings, with price ascending within each tier. Ensure the secondary make/model text filter works across all tiers without breaking tier grouping.
